_comment: The apps on /apps. availability: request (a Request access button) or personal (no button). repo: the GitHub URL once the code is public, else null. screens: image files in static/img/apps/<id>/ (simulator screenshots with sample data); empty shows the placeholder screen. Accents are the apps' own (empire-ios Shared/Design: AppAccent; Aresium's red).
